house.sun-1: A person whose presence walks through the door before they do — you were born to be the protagonist of your life.
house.sun-2: The Sun shining by creating value — earning and accumulating overlap with self-actualization.
house.sun-3: The Sun that shines through speaking and teaching — the storyteller of the neighborhood.
house.sun-4: The Sun in the home — the family is the stage, and one's roots are a source of pride.
house.sun-5: The Sun's most exciting position — creativity, romance, and play are the center of life.
house.sun-6: The Sun shining in the workplace — Competence is identity.
house.sun-7: The Sun fulfilled through relationships — the partner is the co-star of your life.
house.sun-8: The Sun shining through crisis — the self is forged in the midst of transformation.
house.sun-9: The Sun shining toward distant horizons — learning and travel are the fuel for the self.
house.sun-10: The Sun shining at the peak — Career is the backbone of life.
house.sun-11: The Sun shining with the group — it comes most alive when sharing a vision.
house.sun-12: The Sun shining from the unseen — Solitude and spirituality are your headquarters.
house.moon-1: A person whose emotions are reflected directly on their face — honesty is their charm.
house.moon-2: Your bank balance is your emotional thermometer — stable assets are your emotional pillow.
house.moon-3: Finding stability through chatter — daily conversations with those close to you are the remedy.
house.moon-4: A placement where the Moon is in its natural domain — home and family serve as the emotional charging station.
house.moon-5: The Moon recharged by play and romance — pleasure is your emotional vitamin.
house.moon-6: When routines crumble, the heart follows — a regular daily life is your safety net.
house.moon-7: The Moon that waxes when together — the weather of your relationships is your own weather.
house.moon-8: The Moon craving deep intimacy — shallow comfort will not suffice.
house.moon-9: The Moon breathing in unfamiliar places — leaving is a ritual of recovery.
house.moon-10: Finding stability through achievement — you feel at ease when things go well at work.
house.moon-11: The Moon, where a sense of belonging is security — the core is the feeling that "I have people on my side."
house.moon-12: The Moon that requires a cave of its own — time spent emptying the self is a condition for survival.
house.mercury-1: A mind where thought immediately becomes action — your way of speaking is your calling card.
house.mercury-2: A mind quick with money calculations — this is a talent for turning value into language.
house.mercury-3: Mercury in its own house — learning and passing things on is your natural vocation.
house.mercury-4: The family interpreter — clarity comes when you put your inner world into words.
house.mercury-5: A creative mind — it dresses ideas in humor and drama.
house.mercury-6: A mind that designs processes — the craftsperson of work manuals.
house.mercury-7: A mind that builds relationships through conversation — the negotiation table is your home ground.
house.mercury-8: The mind of a deep interviewer — it probes secrets and essentials.
house.mercury-9: A mind that asks big questions — strong in philosophy and foreign languages.
house.mercury-10: The mind of the strategy briefing — you are evaluated through public speech.
house.mercury-11: A mind that thinks through networks — a hub of collective intelligence.
house.mercury-12: A mind that transcribes the language of dreams — intuition arrives before logic.
house.venus-1: A person whose charm is their first impression — they garner favor simply by existing.
house.venus-2: A placement where Venus is in its element — it is the sense of collecting and enjoying beautiful things.
house.venus-3: Venus, the charmer of words — conversational chemistry is the measure of affection.
house.venus-4: Venus, the decorator of the home — hospitality is the language of love.
house.venus-5: Venus in the House of Romance — Romance and creativity are the flowers of life.
house.venus-6: The mood-maker of the workplace — love may blossom amidst camaraderie.
house.venus-7: Venus in the most relational position — partnership is the center of life's aesthetics.
house.venus-8: A deep and fated attraction — love becomes a gateway to transformation.
house.venus-9: Love blooming in foreign lands — fascination with different cultures and philosophies.
house.venus-10: Public Charm — Elegance becomes a career asset.
house.venus-11: Love that grows from friendship — you are drawn to those with whom you share dreams.
house.venus-12: Quietly devoted love — the depth of affection that remains unseen.
house.mars-1: Mars in a place that feels like its own home — drive can be felt in appearance and presence.
house.mars-2: Fighting power directed toward earning — firm when protecting resources.
house.mars-3: The swordsman of speech — sparks fly in debate.
house.mars-4: Energy poured into the household — family matters can become the ignition point for drive.
house.mars-5: Mars comes alive in play where something is at stake — and romance also takes on a conquering style.
house.mars-6: Mars here must guard against workaholism — labor itself becomes the outlet.
house.mars-7: Mars ignites through relationships — this placement learns not to avoid conflict, but to handle it.
house.mars-8: The warrior of crisis response — your real strength emerges in extreme situations.
house.mars-9: Drive toward adventure — Distant goals are the fuel.
house.mars-10: Mars of ambition — professional fighting power that pushes all the way to the summit.
house.mars-11: Fighting for a larger cause — you invest your energy in collective goals.
house.mars-12: Mars fighting where it cannot be seen — the task is to bring the source of anger into consciousness.
house.jupiter-1: A person who walks in with optimism — luck starts working from the first impression.
house.jupiter-2: A hand that gives more as it earns more — this is a placement with a large vessel for resources.
house.jupiter-3: Learning itself becomes luck — teachers and books close to home open the door.
house.jupiter-4: Generous roots — home is a reservoir of luck.
house.jupiter-5: Luck attached to creativity and romance — what you enjoy grows larger.
house.jupiter-6: A placement of work luck and health luck — when routines settle, growth can become substantial.
house.jupiter-7: Benefactors arrive as partners — relationships are the door to expansion.
house.jupiter-8: Reward after crisis — what you enter deeply can return like an inheritance.
house.jupiter-9: Jupiter in its own house — travel, scholarship, and belief become the home base of luck.
house.jupiter-10: Luck attached to career — social trust becomes an asset.
house.jupiter-11: Rich in people — your network is your greatest luck.
house.jupiter-12: An unseen guardian — you may experience paths opening at a dead end.
house.saturn-1: Those who mature early — self-assurance comes late, but it arrives solidly.
house.saturn-2: Training regarding money — overcoming the fear of scarcity to build solid finances.
house.saturn-3: Prudence in speech — even if learning seems slow, it leaves the deepest impression.
house.saturn-4: Homework regarding your roots — taking on family responsibilities to build a true foundation.
house.saturn-5: Permission to enjoy — The task is to practice not questioning your worthiness in play and expression.
house.saturn-6: Discipline of work and the body — If you build a system, you will outlast anyone.
house.saturn-7: The Weight of Relationships — Delayed or cautious unions are often the most durable.
house.saturn-8: The test of trust — one must overcome the fear that precedes deep connection.
house.saturn-9: The Verifier of Beliefs — Accepting only truths that have been personally verified.
house.saturn-10: A placement where Saturn is in its own domain — a "late bloomer" energy that strengthens as one moves into the latter half of life.
house.saturn-11: The Task of Belonging — Moving past the awkwardness within a group to gain true peers.
house.saturn-12: The inner monastery — the task of transforming solitude from fear into a spiritual practice.
house.uranus-1: An indefinable first impression — defying expectations is the identity.
house.uranus-2: A rollercoaster of income — things go well when you earn in unconventional ways.
house.uranus-3: A lightning-fast mind — leaps of thought are part of daily life.
house.uranus-4: Free roots — living with unconventional family history or housing arrangements.
house.uranus-5: Experimental creativity and romance — you quickly grow weary of predictable romances.
house.uranus-6: The innovator of working styles — you do not fit into a rigid 9-to-6.
house.uranus-7: The Freedom Clause of Relationships — You must invent a partnership without constraints.
house.uranus-8: A position that touches upon taboos — crises arrive suddenly, and so does liberation.
house.uranus-9: The Rebel of Beliefs — Breaking established doctrines to forge one's own philosophy.
house.uranus-10: Tectonic shifts in your career — A non-linear professional path is natural for you.
house.uranus-11: A placement where Uranus is at home — someone living in the future.
house.uranus-12: Lightning of the unconscious — intuitive awakenings arrive unexpectedly.
house.neptune-1: A misty atmosphere — mystery is both your charm and a source of misunderstanding.
house.neptune-2: A position where the boundaries of money are blurred — financial matters must be managed with concrete numbers.
house.neptune-3: The language of a poet — an ear that hears nuance rather than mere facts.
house.neptune-4: Idealized roots — The challenge is to separate the myth of the family from reality.
house.neptune-5: The Artist's House — Where ecstasy and disillusionment intersect in creativity and love.
house.neptune-6: The place of service — finding meaning in helping others, and receiving warnings against burnout.
house.neptune-7: The illusion of fated love — practice is needed to see the partner as they truly are.
house.neptune-8: The Gateway of Mysticism — Deep bonds are connected to spiritual experiences.
house.neptune-9: The Seeker's Position — Philosophy and spirituality are the compass.
house.neptune-10: Career as a Calling — Projecting dreams onto one's profession makes managing disillusionment essential.
house.neptune-11: Companions of the Idealists — Dream together, but keep your feet on the ground.
house.neptune-12: Neptune in its own house — the inner ocean is deep, so an anchor is needed.
house.pluto-1: An intense presence — a charisma that leaks out even when one tries to hide it.
house.pluto-2: A deep instinct for resources — learning true value by losing and rebuilding.
house.pluto-3: The power of words — the ability to shift the atmosphere with a single phrase.
house.pluto-4: The Archaeologist of Roots — Digging into the depths of family history to find freedom.
house.pluto-5: Creative Obsession — Betting everything on love and creation.
house.pluto-6: The Transformer of Daily Life — Routines and health become realms of control.
house.pluto-7: The seat of fated relationships — partnership is the crucible of transformation.
house.pluto-8: This is a placement where Pluto is in its own domain — a natural alchemist dealing with endings and beginnings.
house.pluto-9: The Deconstructor of Beliefs — Digging deep toward the truth.
house.pluto-10: The Ladder of Power — Learning the essence of influence in your career.
house.pluto-11: The Transformer of Groups — Observing the hidden dynamics of organizations and communities.
house.pluto-12: The Diver of the Abyss — one who cleanses the deepest room of the unconscious.

sign.sun-aries: A born front-runner — your very presence is a starting signal.
sign.sun-taurus: A slow flame — self-worth that warms up gradually and lasts.
sign.sun-gemini: Someone who shines through stories — words and ideas are your identity.
sign.sun-cancer: A Sun like moonlight — the self is completed by protecting and caring.
sign.sun-leo: The Sun in its own home — wither without expression, warm everyone when you shine.
sign.sun-virgo: A Sun that shines through usefulness — quality is your pride.
sign.sun-libra: A Sun that finds itself in the mirror of relationships.
sign.sun-scorpio: A Sun burning beneath the surface — you never show all of your intensity.
sign.sun-sagittarius: Someone whose identity lies beyond the horizon — stand still and the light dims.
sign.sun-capricorn: A Sun shining from the summit — achievement is proof of being.
sign.sun-aquarius: A Sun that shines from outside the crowd — difference itself is vitality.
sign.sun-pisces: A flowing light — your identity is larger than any fixed frame.
sign.moon-aries: A Moon quick to ignite — anger flares fast and recovers fast.
sign.moon-taurus: One of the Moon's most comfortable seats — stability and a good meal are medicine for the heart.
sign.moon-gemini: A heart that settles only once talked through — conversation is comfort.
sign.moon-cancer: The Moon in its own home — as deep as the sensitivity is, it needs rituals of recovery.
sign.moon-leo: A heart that fills when applauded — recognition is emotional oxygen.
sign.moon-virgo: A Moon that finds calm at a tidy desk — anxiety eases by checking the details.
sign.moon-libra: A Moon that quiets in togetherness — discord is felt in the body first.
sign.moon-scorpio: An all-or-nothing emotional life — once trust is built, it holds deeper than anyone.
sign.moon-sagittarius: A Moon soothed by open horizons — confinement weighs on the mood.
sign.moon-capricorn: A Moon that finds safety in structure — feelings steady once duties are in order.
sign.moon-aquarius: A Moon calmed by a little distance — space is not coldness but breathing room.
sign.moon-pisces: A Moon with porous emotional borders — it needs time alone to drain what it absorbed.
sign.mercury-aries: A mind that speaks from the finish line — words arrive before second thoughts.
sign.mercury-taurus: Slow but exact — once this mind understands, it does not forget.
sign.mercury-gemini: Mercury in its own home — a magician of language, as long as depth is not skipped.
sign.mercury-cancer: A mind that thinks through memory — emotion gives logic its grain.
sign.mercury-leo: A speaking style that dresses stories for the stage — persuasion becomes charisma.
sign.mercury-virgo: Mercury's other home — a craftsperson of analysis, editing, and useful detail.
sign.mercury-libra: A voice that hears both sides before it speaks — mediation comes naturally.
sign.mercury-scorpio: An investigator's mind — the questions go straight to hidden motives.
sign.mercury-sagittarius: A mind that leaps by the big picture — stronger in principles than particulars.
sign.mercury-capricorn: A person who speaks like a report — spare, practical language with no excess.
sign.mercury-aquarius: Thought from an unfamiliar angle — the specialty is turning the frame.
sign.mercury-pisces: A mind that thinks in images instead of logic — the language of metaphor and intuition.
sign.venus-aries: Love that moves straight ahead — directness is more magnetic than strategy.
sign.venus-taurus: Venus in its own home — love through the senses, and linger long enough to savor it.
sign.venus-gemini: Conversation as affection — wit is the first spark of attraction.
sign.venus-cancer: Love proven by care — affection with the warmth of a home-cooked meal.
sign.venus-leo: Love as a festival — bright expression and unmistakable specialness are desired.
sign.venus-virgo: Love spoken through small kindnesses — quiet, steady, and difficult to fake.
sign.venus-libra: Venus's other home — an aesthete of relationship who understands the balance of together.
sign.venus-scorpio: Love that wants all of it — shallow bonds rarely get past the door.
sign.venus-sagittarius: Love that leaves together — it settles with someone who respects freedom.
sign.venus-capricorn: Love built through trust — it does not begin lightly, and it takes responsibility deeply.
sign.venus-aquarius: Love that begins as friendship — affection without ownership is the ideal.
sign.venus-pisces: Venus at its deepest — devoted, but learning to tell dream from reality.
sign.mars-aries: Mars in its own home — ignition is quick and the breakthrough is strong.
sign.mars-taurus: A slow-boiling force — explosions are rare, but stopping is hard once it moves.
sign.mars-gemini: Mars that fights with words — debate becomes sparring.
sign.mars-cancer: Anger that moves sideways — held too long, it leaks out as hurt.
sign.mars-leo: Mars that fights for honor — disrespect is what makes the fire rise.
sign.mars-virgo: Mars with a precise strike — criticism becomes the chosen weapon.
sign.mars-libra: Mars that tries to avoid the fight — yet turns firm in the face of unfairness.
sign.mars-scorpio: Mars at its deepest — quiet, relentless, and willing to go to the end.
sign.mars-sagittarius: Drive aimed at a cause — the farther the goal, the stronger the fire.
sign.mars-capricorn: A strategist's Mars — it wins through steadiness, not emotional display.
sign.mars-aquarius: Mars against the system — it comes alive when fighting unjust rules.
sign.mars-pisces: Mars without a straight line — it reaches the goal by following the current.
sign.jupiter-aries: Luck that grows through challenge — doors open for the one who moves first.
sign.jupiter-taurus: Accumulation becomes expansion — what is built slowly swells the largest.
sign.jupiter-gemini: Luck in learning and connection — opportunity arrives through people and ideas.
sign.jupiter-cancer: Luck that grows by sheltering — a familial circle becomes the soil of growth.
sign.jupiter-leo: A placement with a widening stage — fortune follows when expression gets larger.
sign.jupiter-virgo: Luck in the details — refined skill becomes the path of expansion.
sign.jupiter-libra: Luck that grows between people — partnership is the engine of growth.
sign.jupiter-scorpio: Fortune that enlarges through crisis — the deeper the descent, the greater the return.
sign.jupiter-sagittarius: Jupiter in its own home — exploration itself becomes the generator of luck.
sign.jupiter-capricorn: Luck rewarded at the summit — responsibility sets the scale of expansion.
sign.jupiter-aquarius: Luck born from difference — opportunity belongs to the one redrawing the board.
sign.jupiter-pisces: Jupiter's old home — the more generously it gives, the wider the mysterious math becomes.
sign.saturn-aries: A lesson in governing haste — learn patience, and courage becomes adult.
sign.saturn-taurus: A lesson in possession and safety — the standard for enough must be rebuilt.
sign.saturn-gemini: A lesson in the weight of words — one sentence with depth is the assignment.
sign.saturn-cancer: A lesson in emotional expression — weakness can be shown without collapse.
sign.saturn-leo: A lesson in standing without applause — self-worth beyond recognition is the task.
sign.saturn-virgo: A lesson in making peace with perfectionism — good enough must be allowed.
sign.saturn-libra: A lesson in the responsibility of relationship — balance is learned between alone and together.
sign.saturn-scorpio: A lesson in releasing control — trust is the hardest homework.
sign.saturn-sagittarius: A lesson in testing belief — optimism needs a structure it can stand on.
sign.saturn-capricorn: Saturn in its own home — even if late, it arrives more solid than anyone.
sign.saturn-aquarius: A lesson in joining ideal and reality — innovation must learn responsibility.
sign.saturn-pisces: A lesson in boundaries — even empathy needs a fence.
sign.uranus-aries: A pioneering generation — it breaks the old starting line and lays a new track.
sign.uranus-taurus: A generation of ownership revolution — the rules of money and resources are rewritten.
sign.uranus-gemini: A generation of information revolution — speech and media change their form.
sign.uranus-cancer: A generation of family revolution — the meaning of home is asked again.
sign.uranus-leo: A generation of expressive revolution — the grammar of creation and the stage is changed.
sign.uranus-virgo: A generation of labor revolution — the act of working is reinvented.
sign.uranus-libra: A generation of relationship revolution — partnership becomes an experiment.
sign.uranus-scorpio: A generation that dismantles taboo — hidden power structures are exposed.
sign.uranus-sagittarius: A generation of belief revolution — religion and education are shaken at the frame.
sign.uranus-capricorn: A generation of institutional revolution — systems and authority are rebuilt.
sign.uranus-aquarius: Uranus in its own home — the archetype of futurism.
sign.uranus-pisces: A generation of sensitivity revolution — the banks of the collective unconscious are opened.
sign.neptune-aries: The dream of the hero — a generation that turns personal courage into myth.
sign.neptune-taurus: The dream of abundance — a generation seeking meaning inside matter.
sign.neptune-gemini: The dream of story — a generation intoxicated with media and narrative.
sign.neptune-cancer: The dream of return — roots and refuge are idealized.
sign.neptune-leo: The dream of romance — love and creation are treated almost as faith.
sign.neptune-virgo: The dream of healing — health and service are idealized.
sign.neptune-libra: The dream of harmony — a collective longing for relationship and peace.
sign.neptune-scorpio: The dream of the abyss — a generation drawn to the mysteries of death and rebirth.
sign.neptune-sagittarius: The dream of pilgrimage — a collective search for truth across distant roads.
sign.neptune-capricorn: The dream of order — a blueprint for the ideal society.
sign.neptune-aquarius: The dream of utopia — a generation trying to build heaven through technology and solidarity.
sign.neptune-pisces: Neptune in its own home — dream itself becomes the spirit of the age.
sign.pluto-aries: War and the transformation of the individual — the heroic story is rewritten.
sign.pluto-taurus: The transformation of economic structures — value and ownership are born again.
sign.pluto-gemini: The transformation of information power — words become weapons.
sign.pluto-cancer: The transformation of family structures — the source of safety is redefined.
sign.pluto-leo: The transformation of authority and creation — the myths of stardom and self are rewritten.
sign.pluto-virgo: The transformation of work and health — power structures in daily life are exposed.
sign.pluto-libra: The transformation of relational contracts — marriage and alliance are reconstructed.
sign.pluto-scorpio: Pluto in its own home — a generation that looks straight at taboo and death.
sign.pluto-sagittarius: The transformation of belief systems — the authority of religion and truth is rearranged.
sign.pluto-capricorn: The transformation of institutional power — the bones of nations and corporations are reset.
sign.pluto-aquarius: The transformation of technological power — networks become the new throne.
sign.pluto-pisces: The transformation of the collective unconscious — a vast turning point where boundaries dissolve.
